references.name: front-2025.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected complete November2025 street-front oblique. Red brick historic station: tall central body flanked by two low gabled wings; pale green copper roofs; three street-facing front gables with larger central clock gable; prominent brick chimneys and small cap/finial details; round-arched ground windows and closed central entrance, square/segmental upper windows, decorative brick courses. Rounded two-story bay with curved green cap lies left/negativeX of center. Modern rail platforms/canopies are independent behind. Green sculpture,streetscape,trees andvehicles are outside principal building scope.

references.name: station-2021.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected complete street front in2021. Both low wings,central three-level facade,three front gables,large clock disc,tall chimneys,closed green sheet roofs,rounded left bay,central entrance and arched ground glazing are present. Main doors/window frames are dark brown,with pale masonry outlines/courses. Rear/side hidden window inventory and exact brick/clock ornament are inferred medium-fi details; no exact lettering or sculpture copy.

note: Two ordinary reference pictures stay local; not redistributed or used as textures. No bespoke archival,survey or alternate terrain research.
